chunks: Inquire of apostles We had sent before you if We appointed gods to be worshipped other than Ar-Rahman.

key_terms.الرَّحْمَٰنِ: The Most Merciful, a key divine attribute

ai.seo_question: What did God ask the Prophet to inquire about from previous messengers regarding worship?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm the continuity of the prophetic mission (Tawatur al-Rusul), demonstrating that the core message of Tawhid remained unchanged across all divine dispensations. It serves as a logical proof for the Prophet Muhammad's authority, validating his claim by linking him to the unbroken chain of previous messengers who worshipped none but Allah. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on the consistency of Islamic doctrine against polytheistic innovations.
